relationships.subject: Estrogen receptor alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal application of ERα siRNA significantly reduced VHS, decreased lumbar-sacral spinal cord expression of both ERα and BDNF

relationships.subject: 5HT3A receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Serotonin-mediated activation of 5HT3A receptors in the spinal cord drives the development of enhanced female-specific VHS in our two hit CPS+CAS through up-regulation of spinal cord ERα.

relationships.subject: Alosetron
relationships.evidence_quote: During CAS, intrathecal infusion of alosetron significantly decreased VHS, reduced BDNF and ERα expression in the LS spinal cord

key_findings: Spinal ERα drives BDNF transcription and enhanced visceral hypersensitivity in female CPS+CAS rats.
Spinal serotonin acting on 5HT3A receptors increases ERα and BDNF; alosetron reverses this.
